entities.summary: Cole Dickson Beasley is an American former professional football player who was a wide receiver in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the SMU Mustangs and was signed by the Dallas Cowboys as an undrafted free agent in 2012. Beasley also played three seasons for the Buffalo Bills before retiring with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in 2022. He came out of retirement a few months later in the season to re-sign with the Bills.
